qaLog.question: When someone watches a Noodlz video, what should they come away with?
qaLog.answer: A mix, and let the data decide per week
options: A player getting better, on camera
Vibes and comedy with friends
Hype highlights, as good as they can look
A mix, and let the data decide per week

qaLog.question: What does a week's output look like?
qaLog.answer: i decide which games you do for now... you can help recommend me videos with the amount of multikills we have... what do beginner youtubers do?... you make the shorts, we can try some various long games, and when we have something we're happy with we can do the automation for shorts and longs
options: 3 shorts + 1 long piece, every week
Shorts weekly, long piece only when a game earns it
Shorts only until the long-form pipeline is proven

qaLog.question: Which long-video experiment goes first?
qaLog.answer: Story of the Jhin game, 4-6 min
options: Story of the Jhin game, 4-6 min
Music montage across the Nov 20 games, 60-90 s
Full-game commentary cut, 8-12 min
qaLog.note: first attempt was replaced by a pasted Lead-bot message (four pipeline ideas); re-asked

qaLog.question: Whose voice carries the Jhin story video?
qaLog.answer: Live mic for the fights, recorded narration for the setup
options: My live mic from the game, cleaned up
I record a narration afterwards
Live mic for the fights, recorded narration for the setup
No voice: captions and title cards only

qaLog.question: Hybrid is the most work; which build order?
qaLog.answer: Live mic cut first, narration added in experiment 2
options: Live mic cut first, narration added in experiment 2
Both at once, one experiment
Narration first, live mic later

qaLog.question: What does early-game content mean to you?
qaLog.answer: Short-form lane moments: trades and escapes... but not 20-40 s... in long videos big trades, how I played the first 2 levels, kills, deaths, gank attempts; in shorts how we trade, how we get kills, assists
options: The lane as a chapter of the story video
Short-form lane moments: trades and escapes
Educational: 'what I was trying in lane' voice-over
Not now

qaLog.question: Does the funny bucket get an exception to the on-screen-event rule?
qaLog.answer: keepers can be my comms too. even if nothing happens, if i'm describing something or have a weird reaction, it's a keeper, but lower confidence or an 'informational' bucket... this is how we spin up a story per game
options: Yes, funny clips can be voice-only, with a visible reaction
Yes, pure voice-only funny clips are fine
No, the rule stands for every bucket

qaLog.question: Where does the music montage land now?
qaLog.answer: Run it in parallel now, it is mostly built
options: Experiment 3, after the story works
Run it in parallel now, it is mostly built
Drop it; montages are not this channel

qaLog.question: Where does music come from, and who uploads?
qaLog.answer: put some into our folder and i'll recommend some into a separate folder; fan of old EDM: 2012 (If The World Would End), Dead by Stan SB, Monody by TheFatRat, Goodbye Moonmen, Truth by Tristam, Until The World Ends by Arch Tremors; they may not be royalty free
options: YouTube Audio Library tracks, I upload myself
Any track I send, pipeline uploads to YouTube
Pipeline picks from a licensed catalogue
qaLog.note: upload half unanswered; ruled: no upload code, owner posts by hand

qaLog.question: What do the bots own once they are back on Friday?
qaLog.answer: you and bots will be synonymous. bots have ownership and know how everything works, you in the loop: main code reviewer and coder while i'm home; when i'm out you come up with tasks and the jiras and the bots implement while i'm at work, do the editing and show me vids
options: Bots get the small pipeline tasks, I keep content and new modules
Bots own the whole backlog, I only review
Bots stay on reviews and Drive chores only

qaLog.answer: yes, attack the spec and go ahead and implement. i'm gonna nap

claims.claim: Four montage entry points all render one 9:16 short via render_short; custom_montage takes an ordered clip_paths list + music_path; layouts are blur_fill and cropped_hud only; beat snap exists but no caller enables it

plan_arc exists in music/arc.py but is unwired; compilation path (compile.py) is 16:9 1920x1080 with intro/main/outro narrative plan and per-clip captions; shorts path caps 180 s / 300 s timeout / 720x1280
Transcription reads the default audio stream; no -map, no mic/game separation, no diarization, no TTS; voiceover mode only ducks and writes a prompt
OwnerFrame holds minute/gold/cs/level for the owner only; no lane state, CS diff or opponent frames
Mentor table has hype/story/voice_over/funny; arc_montage only in code; 11 league corrections dated 2026-11-22
download_music writes WORKSPACE/music; library.py expects WORKSPACE/media_library/music/library.json; one track; no licence notes; no YouTube upload code
